status: Shared output owner, both GUI workspaces, CLI compact EPS and persistence verified. Native quit remains unfinished. The later full-window Reset capture retains exporter values for one starting state; see application-reset-contract.json.

verification.coreScope: The full core run predates the new compact CLI test. The subsequent entire CLI-batch file passes all 43 tests. Numerical source files did not change during the run.
verification.browser: Visible defaults, keyboard layout selection, single/batch/single sharing, format-specific enabled state, compact thin-stroke EPS download and actual host restart without reseeding.

behavior.ownership: One GuiEngine output-options owner supplies the single-image GUI and batch processing flow. Both pass selected snapshots explicitly to the existing per-call writer methods. Browser and batch snapshots are owned projections, not separate settings owners.
behavior.rustCli: vectorize and batch overlay explicit export flags on these application defaults. Standalone export-* commands retain their per-call serializer defaults. Geometry-corpus comparisons explicitly select their reference writer's layout and, for DXF, curve mode; the default-conversion checks compare the application defaults independently.
behavior.lifetime: Preserve options through workspace changes and application model reset. Save/restore them once at the processing-preference root; remove the earlier batch-local preference field. Invalid old local files fail with explicit recovery instructions; no migration or compatibility path.
behavior.api: POST /api/outputOptions applies validated partial changes in either idle workspace and publishes batch state before replying. The single-image GUI sends its complete selected options in the export query. The export endpoint and writer methods keep their existing per-call defaults and never read hidden application settings.
behavior.limits: Native quit ordering, active-job shutdown and broader full-window Reset starting states remain unverified. This historical corpus changes business-model settings only and never answers a native dialog; later full-window evidence is recorded in application-reset-contract.json.
